prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1058; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision in which our client was struck by your insured's vehicle while our client was lawfully making a left turn. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Effective immediately, please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, in person, by telephone, or in writing. If your insured has been in contact with our client or any representative of your company, please let us know.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page. We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data, witness statements, claim notes, recorded statements, and any repair or inspection records, until this matter is fully resolved.
